summary: Independent review of the updated Release Intelligence v2.0.0-GA GOLDEN BUILD ZIP SHA256 1634324884ad31080ed82b1fcd839d7e05e07253df73e95d2102a35fe1121022. All 28 packaged files byte-match source. Client and server claim checks now isolate coordinated subjects, require material subject matches, and preserve normalized validation/design/review phases; the previously reproduced cross-item and dropped-validation-phase errors are covered and rejected. Monthly writes reorder dated sections oldest-first while retaining undated ranges and balanced rich-text fragments, failing closed when safe preservation cannot be established. Expand/collapse-all controls and whole metric tiles retain state and accessible labels. Slack Nudge uses fresh GUS Development Lead identity plus saved year mappings and optional identity resolution, prepares escaped editable text, and contains no send operation. Independently executed all 41 focused parser, grounding, AI, and nudge tests successfully. No blocking issues remain. Overall application risk remains High under the existing rubric assessment.
caveats: Claim checks are strict linguistic heuristics, not a proof of factual grounding or complete coverage. They can reject valid paraphrases and cannot exhaust every misleading formulation; source fallbacks and human review remain necessary. Goals, Closed status, review readiness, release, deployment, and production must remain distinct.

Chronological ordering changes section positions during explicit monthly writes. Ambiguous years and rich markup that cannot be safely reconstructed fail closed with the draft retained; arbitrary HTML structures are not guaranteed to reorder successfully.

Slack Nudge prepares a reminder only. It does not send a DM. Recipient matching requires the optional host resolveIdentity capability; otherwise users must copy the message and choose the Development Lead in Slack. User review is required before manual sending.
Current GUS Apps host metadata still relies on verified-definition snapshots; automatic future list-column detection remains unavailable without live list-view REST capability.

Existing usage completeness, preview cache/cancellation, popup accessibility/scroll, refresh concurrency, journal growth, revision conflicts, non-atomic updates, preference semantics, host/catalog/history limits, and AllUsers sharing caveats remain.

This review combined static source/artifact inspection with 41 independently executed focused tests. The implementing agent reported all 156 Node tests, GA-controls, monthly-AI, comment-heading browser suites, and mocked deployment checks passed. Those full suites, production LLM/browser behavior, actual Slack identity resolution, remote publication, and golden-tag movement were not independently verified.
